leadText:
Area 28 (Japanese: エリア２８ Area 28) is an -exclusive location in the Unova region. It exists along and is notorious for sightings. 

Professor Icarus lived there after he quit his job as a university professor in order to work on ways to manipulate . It was also where he encountered , a Pokémon considered to be .

Area 28 is largely desert, with one diner and Professor Icarus's laboratory the main points of interest.
